one_line_description: Customer support software with ticketing and automation features
auth_methods_evidence: Freshdesk uses Basic Auth with API key as username. Composio lists API_KEY, Nango lists BASIC — both are correct (the API key IS sent via Basic auth header). https://developers.freshdesk.com/api/
self_serve_evidence: The Freshdesk API documentation is publicly accessible at https://developers.freshdesk.com/api/ and includes authentication information, suggesting developers can self-serve credentials.
buildability_rationale: Self-serve API with good documentation and broad API surface, though requires API key authentication.
agent_notes: Freshdesk provides a comprehensive REST API with extensive endpoints for support and helpdesk operations. The API uses API key authentication and is well-documented. Composio registry confirms 178 tools are available. [NANGO CROSS-CHECK: Nango lists BASIC, Composio lists API_KEY. Both correct — Freshdesk sends API key via Basic auth header. Updated to include both.]
